name: endurance-20s
description: Long sensorless endurance run (~20 s): 1.5 A punch through the L(f) band to the no-load ceiling, then a staircase of torque steps (0.5/1.0/0.5/1.2 A) held seconds each — all above the problematic omega_e 400-800 band. Exercises sustained closed-loop drive, torque step response, the deadman/affirm path over many seconds, and telemetry endurance at 1 kHz.
